ORION PIT WALL - POSTGRES
Race-session scan view using only the Orion Postgres datasource. Pick a Run, then scrub the Grafana time range for recent or retrospective analysis.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS effective_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS effective_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
       AVG(d.accel_pedal_travel) AS "accel pedal [%]", AVG(c.apps1_travel) AS "apps1 [%]", AVG(c.apps2_travel) AS "apps2 [%]",
       AVG(c.brake_pressure_f) AS "brake front [psi]", AVG(c.brake_pressure_rall) AS "brake rear left [psi]", AVG(c.brake_pressure_rbll) AS "brake rear right [psi]", AVG(d.steer_col_angle) AS "steer [deg]"
FROM packet p JOIN dynamics d ON d.packet_id = p.packet_id LEFT JOIN controls c ON c.packet_id = p.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS effective_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS effective_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
       AVG(d.flw_speed) AS "FL [rad/s]", AVG(d.frw_speed) AS "FR [rad/s]", AVG(d.blw_speed) AS "RL [rad/s]", AVG(d.brw_speed) AS "RR [rad/s]",
       AVG((d.flw_speed + d.frw_speed) / 2.0) AS "front avg [rad/s]", AVG((d.blw_speed + d.brw_speed) / 2.0) AS "rear avg [rad/s]",
       AVG(100.0 * (((d.blw_speed + d.brw_speed) / 2.0) - ((d.flw_speed + d.frw_speed) / 2.0)) / NULLIF(((d.flw_speed + d.frw_speed) / 2.0), 0)) AS "rear slip [%]"
FROM packet p JOIN dynamics d ON d.packet_id = p.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

FROM packet p JOIN controls c ON c.packet_id = p.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
       AVG(th.motor_temp) AS "motor [C]", AVG(th.inverter_temp) AS "inverter [C]", AVG(th.inverter_hotspot_temp) AS "hotspot [C]", AVG(th.batt_loop_batt_temp) AS "battery [C]", AVG(th.coolant_temp) AS "coolant [C]", AVG(th.cell_top_temp) AS "cell top [C]", AVG(th.cell_bottom_temp) AS "cell bottom [C]"
FROM packet p JOIN thermal th ON th.packet_id = p.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS effective_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS effective_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
       AVG(pk.hv_soc) AS "SOC [%]", AVG(pk.hv_pack_v) AS "HV pack [V]", AVG(pk.hv_c) AS "HV current [A]", AVG(pk.dc_bus_v) AS "DC bus [V]", AVG(pk.lv_batt_v) AS "LV battery [V]", AVG(pk.lv_batt_c) AS "LV current [A]"
FROM packet p JOIN pack pk ON pk.packet_id = p.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS effective_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS effective_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dh.stomp_fault THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stomp_fault, MAX(CASE WHEN dl.bmb_comm_error THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bmb_comm_error, MAX(CASE WHEN dl.imd_gnd_isolation_error THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS imd_gnd_isolation_error,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dl.r2d_authorized THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r2d_authorized, MAX(CASE WHEN dl.r2d_status THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r2d_status,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dl.shutdown_leg1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shutdown_leg1, MAX(CASE WHEN dl.shutdown_leg2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shutdown_leg2, MAX(CASE WHEN dl.shutdown_leg3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shutdown_leg3, MAX(CASE WHEN dl.shutdown_leg4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shutdown_leg4,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dh.pos_hv_contactor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pos_hv_contactor, MAX(CASE WHEN dh.neg_hv_contactor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_hv_contactor, MAX(CASE WHEN dh.precharge_contactor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS precharge_contactor
FROM packet p LEFT JOIN diagnostics_high dh ON dh.packet_id = p.packet_id LEFT JOIN diagnostics_low dl ON dl.packet_id = p.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;
